title: Design System: Golden Friendship Family Clinic
sourceOfTruth: DESIGN.md (this sidecar mirrors it; update both together)

primary.purpose: Actions, active states, confirmed records, focus. The authoritative color.

field.purpose: Owns whole regions: public hero, auth split panel, every page masthead. Secondary text on it is --field-muted #b9cfc1, never translucent white.

gold.purpose: Marks time, money, and the next thing that matters — never decoration. Text-sized gold under 18px uses --gold-ink #8a650a.

background.purpose: The ground. Every page background. Never pure white — white is reserved for paper that lifts off the cream.

sidebar.purpose: The navigation rail. Gold monogram seal, serif clinic name, gold left rule on the active item.

board.purpose: The one step darker than the ground, used only for the landing community board.

highlight.purpose: The fill behind the step you are currently standing on in a multi-part flow.

display.purpose: The clinic's own voice — the name on the public hero only.

title.purpose: Every page title, inside the PageMasthead. Never bold — single weight, structurally enforced.

stat-figure.purpose: The single number a report exists to answer with.

section.purpose: Card and block headings. The serif never appears here.

lead.purpose: The one explanatory sentence under a title.

data.purpose: Every time, date, count, percentage, phone and payment reference — mono with tabular figures, via .figure. Nothing else uses mono.

shadows.name: warm
shadows.purpose: Standard paper elevation: cards, toolbars, inline records, pinned notices.

shadows.name: warm-lg
shadows.purpose: The board container and every masthead.

motion.name: ease-quint
motion.purpose: The single easing for all motion (var(--ease-quint)).

motion.name: ink-in
motion.purpose: Ledger rows ink onto the page in reading order; stagger is authored via --i on each row.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.purpose: A masthead's gold hairline drawing itself across the top, once per page.

motion.name: pin-settle
motion.purpose: Landing page pinned notices settle onto the board.

motion.name: page-enter
motion.purpose: Route transition fade-in for dashboard content areas.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → animation: none on all four; ink-in delay forced to 0ms

components.name: PageMasthead
components.description: Every authenticated page's identity carrier. Deep field, rounded-2xl, gold hairline drawing itself across the top (rule-draw), optional tracked meta line, serif title, optional lead, optional actions slot, optional MastheadStats strip along the foot (mono figures, tone gold reserved for the count that needs acting on).

components.css: .ds-ledger { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid #e7e2d9; } .ds-ledger-row { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 1fr; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 16px; row-gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e7e2d9; padding: 14px 0; animation: ds-ink-in 0.44s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 28ms); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-ledger-row { grid-template-columns: 5.5rem 1fr auto; padding: 12px 0; } } .ds-ledger-row:last-child { border-bottom-width: 0; } .ds-ledger-time { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger-name { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; } .ds-ledger-note { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #78716c; margin: 2px 0 0; } @keyframes ds-ink-in { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 6px; } to { opacity: 1; translate: 0 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ledger-row { animation: none; animation-delay: 0ms; } }

components.name: StatusMark
components.description: States as inked marks, not pills: squared (rounded-sm), mono, uppercase, tracked, colored border with tinted fill. Pending is gold, confirmed is primary, cancelled is destructive. Copy is spelled out — 'Awaiting action', not the raw enum.
components.html: Awaiting action Confirmed Cancelled
components.css: .ds-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; border: 1px solid; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mark-pending { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #b8860b 45%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, #b8860b 12%, transparent); color: #8a650a; } .ds-mark-confirmed { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #1a5c3a 45%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, #1a5c3a 10%, transparent); color: #1a5c3a; } .ds-mark-cancelled { border-color: color-mix(in oklab, #c0392b 40%, transparent); background: color-mix(in oklab, #c0392b 8%, transparent); color: #c0392b; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action. Forest green background, cream text, rounded-lg, warm focus ring. Also: field (cream on the deep field), field-outline, and gold — gold is for money and payment actions only.

components.name: Field Button
components.description: The action that sits on the deep field — cream paper on forest, used in the hero, mastheads and the auth panel.

narrative.northStar: Warm Confidence, deepened — the clinic's front wall and its desk book
narrative.overview: The clinic has two real objects and the interface is built from both. Outward is the front wall: a deep forest field carrying the name, the live hours, and the honest three-step flow, with a community board of pinned notices below it. Inward is the desk book: the ruled appointment ledger the front desk actually worked from — a time running down the left gutter, records entered in reading order, states written down as inked marks rather than colored pills. The palette owns regions instead of scattering accents: the deep field carries context and identity, the warm cream ground carries records and forms.
keyCharacteristics: Two zones: deep forest field for context and identity, warm cream ground for records and forms
Gold carries information, never decoration — time, money, and the next thing that matters
Ten type registers including a mono data layer for every figure the clinic reads off a screen
Ruled lines, a time gutter, and squared inked state marks — the desk book's vocabulary
Warm offset shadows; paper objects sit on a desk, they do not glow; no backdrop blur anywhere
Light only, deliberately: this is a daylight clinic with no dark rendition

rules.name: The Gold Has a Job Rule
rules.body: Gold marks time, money, and the next thing that matters — and nothing else. Permitted: board pins, the current step, a PENDING state, a placeholder input, a payment reference or money figure, the current day, the still-to-come / needs-attendance count, and the masthead hairline. Gold on a decorative dot, a generic icon, or a bullet is a bug. Gold text under 18px uses --gold-ink #8a650a.

rules.name: The Two-Zone Rule
rules.body: Context and identity are set on the deep field. Records, forms, and anything read for minutes at a time sit on cream. Never a form on the field; never a masthead on cream.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Page backgrounds are never pure white. White is reserved for paper that lifts off the cream.

rules.name: The Single Weight Rule
rules.body: DM Serif Display ships one weight. Never font-semibold/bold on a serif heading — .font-heading sets font-weight 400 and font-synthesis-weight: none to make faux-bold structurally impossible.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Figures Rule
rules.body: If a value is a time, date, count, percentage, phone number, or payment reference, it is .figure (Geist Mono, tabular, slashed zero). If it is prose, it is not.

rules.name: The No Serif in Chrome Rule
rules.body: The serif never appears in navigation, buttons, badges, table headers, or body text. A card heading is the section register, not serif.

rules.name: The Radius Consistency Rule
rules.body: Cards rounded-xl (8.75px), controls rounded-lg (6.25px), mastheads rounded-2xl, status marks squared rounded-sm — never pills.

rules.name: The No Glass Rule
rules.body: Backdrop blur is banned anywhere in the app. Depth comes from warm offset shadows and warm borders only. No gray shadows, no transition-all, no gradient text.

dos: Do open every authenticated page with PageMasthead carrying that page's real context — the date, the counts, the primary action
Do set every time, date, count, percentage, phone and payment reference in .figure (mono, tabular)
Do use Ledger/LedgerRow/LedgerHeading for any list of records
Do use StatusMark for appointment states rather than inventing a badge
Do keep gold to its permitted jobs, and use --gold-ink for gold text below 18px
Do use shadow-warm/shadow-warm-lg on paper, and nothing on the page itself
Do wrap every animation in a prefers-reduced-motion guard
Do use role="alert" for errors and role="status" for results that must survive a toast
Do keep aria-hidden on decorative icons and give every icon-only control an accessible name
donts: Don't put a form, table, or ledger on the deep field
Don't use font-semibold with the serif face
Don't use pills for status, or rounded-full on cards and containers
Don't apply gold to decoration: a stray dot, a generic icon, a divider that means nothing
Don't use pure white as a page background; the ground is cream
Don't use gray shadows, transition-all, gradient text, glass, or decorative blur
Don't render a placeholder value as if it were real — the public phone shows a clearly-marked sample number until the clinic sets a real one
Don't add kicker lines, eyebrow labels, or section numbers above headings
Don't repeat a page title in both the masthead and the first card
